Subject: Indian History
Topic: Ancient India
Subtopics: Indus Valley Civilization, Vedic period (Early & Later), Mahajanapadas, Rise of Magadha, Buddhism & Jainism, Mauryan Empire (Administration, Ashoka's Dhamma, Edicts), Post-Mauryan period (Kushanas, Satavahanas), Gupta Empire (Golden Age, Literature, Science & Art), Post-Gupta Era (Harshavardhana), Southern Dynasties (Cholas, Pallavas, Chalukyas, Rashtrakutas)

Subject: Indian History
Topic: Medieval India
Subtopics: Early Medieval India, Delhi Sultanate (Slave, Khilji, Tughlaq, Sayyid, Lodi dynasties; Alauddin Khilji's market reforms, Muhammad bin Tughlaq's experiments), Administration & Agrarian systems under Sultanate, Mughal Empire (Babur to Aurangzeb; Akbar's administrative policies, Mansabdari & Jagirdari systems, Religious policy), Decline of Mughals, Vijayanagara Empire & Bahmani Kingdom, Maratha Empire (Shivaji & Peshwas), Bhakti Movement (Kabir, Guru Nanak, Chaitanya, Mirabai) & Sufi Movement

Subject: Indian History
Topic: Modern Indian History & National Movement
Subtopics: Advent of European powers (Portuguese, Dutch, French, British), British conquest of Bengal (Plassey 1757, Buxar 1764), Dual Government, Governor-Generals & Viceroys, Economic impact of British rule (Drain of Wealth theory, Land revenue settlements - Permanent Settlement, Ryotwari, Mahalwari), Revolt of 1857 (causes, leaders, suppression, Government of India Act 1858), 19th Century Socio-Religious Reform Movements (Brahmo Samaj, Arya Samaj, Prarthana Samaj, Ramakrishna Mission, Theosophical Society, Aligarh Movement), Growth of Indian Nationalism, Foundation of INC (1885), Moderate Phase (1885–1905), Extremist Phase & Swadeshi Movement (1905–1911), Surat Split (1907), Morley-Minto Reforms (1909), Home Rule Movement (1916), Lucknow Pact (1916), Gandhian Era (Champaran, Kheda, Ahmedabad Mill Strike), Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms (1919), Rowlatt Act & Jallianwala Bagh (1919), Non-Cooperation & Khilafat Movement (1920–22), Swaraj Party, Simon Commission (1927), Nehru Report (1928), Purna Swaraj Declaration (1929), Civil Disobedience Movement & Dandi March (1930), Gandhi-Irwin Pact, Round Table Conferences, Poona Pact (1932), Government of India Act 1935, Provincial Elections (1937), August Offer (1940), Individual Satyagraha, Cripps Mission (1942), Quit India Movement (1942), Indian National Army (INA) & Subhas Chandra Bose, CR Formula, Wavell Plan & Simla Conference (1945), Cabinet Mission Plan (1946), Mountbatten Plan & Indian Independence Act 1947, Partition and Integration of Princely States

Subject: History of Assam
Topic: Ancient Assam (Pragjyotisha & Kamarupa)
Subtopics: Pre-historic & Proto-historic Assam, Sources of Ancient Assam History (Nidhanpur & Doobi Copperplate inscriptions, Allahabad Pillar inscription, Tezpur Rock inscription), Epics & Puranic accounts (Naraka, Bhagadatta), Varman Dynasty (Pushyavarman, Samudravarman, Bhaskaravarman, Alliance with Harshavardhana, Account of Xuanzang/Hiuen Tsang), Salastambha Dynasty (Harjaravarman, Vanamalavarmadeva), Pala Dynasty of Kamarupa (Brahmapala, Ratnapala, Dharmapala), Society, Economy, Religion, Art & Architecture of Kamarupa

Subject: History of Assam
Topic: Medieval Assam (Ahom, Koch, Chutiya, Kachari Kingdoms)
Subtopics: Establishment of Ahom Kingdom by Chaolung Sukapha (1228 AD), Consolidation of Ahom rule, Chutiya Kingdom (Gaurinarayan, Sati Sadhani), Kachari Kingdom (Hidimba, Maibang, Khaspur), Koch Kingdom (Biswa Singha, Naranarayan, Chilarai / Sukladhwaj, Division of Koch Kingdom into Koch Hajo and Koch Behar), Suhungmung (Dihingia Raja - expansion, introduction of Saka Era, first census), Pratap Singha (administrative reforms, Momai Tamuli Barbarua, Paik & Khel System, creation of Barbarua & Borphukan posts), Mughal-Ahom Conflicts, Mir Jumla's Invasion of Assam (1662-63, Treaty of Ghilajharighat), Chakradhwaj Singha, Battle of Alaboi (1669), Battle of Saraighat (1671 - Lachit Borphukan, Naval battle tactics on Brahmaputra), Udayaditya Singha, Battle of Itakhuli (1682 - Mansur Khan defeated, Western boundary fixed at Manas river), Gadadhar Singha (establishment of Tungkhungia dynasty), Rudra Singha (Siva Singha, Ambika, Joymoti sacrifice, Rang Ghar, Kareng Ghar, Talatal Ghar, architecture, Trade relations with Tibet & Bengal), Ahom Administration, Paik system, Khel system, Chamua, Posha system, Moamoria Rebellion (causes, Mayamara Satra, three phases of rebellion, Purnananda Burhagohain), Captain Welsh's Expedition (1792-94), Burmese Invasions of Assam (Maanar Din - three invasions 1817, 1819, 1821; Badan Chandra Borphukan, atrocities), Fall of Ahom Kingdom, Anglo-Burmese War (1824-26), Treaty of Yandaboo (24th February 1826 - End of Ahom independence, Annexation by British East India Company)

Subject: History of Assam
Topic: Modern Assam & Freedom Struggle
Subtopics: Early British Administration (David Scott, Robertson, Jenkins), Annexation of Cachar, Jaintia, Matak, Khamti and Hill areas, Anti-British Uprisings (Gomdhar Konwar 1828, Piyoli Phukan & Jeuram Dulia Baruah 1830), Discovery of Tea in Assam (Robert Bruce 1823, C.A. Bruce, Assam Tea Company 1839), Waste Land Rules & Tea Plantations, Indentured Tea Garden Labourers (Coolie system), Annexation of Assam to Bengal Presidency (1836-1873) & Imposition of Bengali language, Struggle for restoration of Assamese language (American Baptist Missionaries - Nathan Brown, Miles Bronson, Oronodoi 1846, Anandaram Dhekial Phukan, Hemchandra Baruah, Gunabhiram Baruah), Revolt of 1857 in Assam (Maniram Dewan's role, Piyoli Baruah, Execution at Jorhat 1858), Creation of Chief Commissionership of Assam (1874), Peasant Uprisings against British Revenue Policies (Ryot Sabhas, Phulaguri Dhawa 1861 - First Peasant Uprising in Assam against Opium tax, Rangiya Peasant Uprising 1893-94, Lachima Uprising 1894, Patharughat Ran 1894 - Assam's Jallianwala Bagh, 140 peasants martyred), Socio-Cultural & Political Organizations (Asom Desh Hitaishini Sabha, Sarbajanik Sabha of Jorhat 1884 by Jagannath Baruah, Assam Association 1903 by Manik Chandra Baruah, Asam Sahitya Sabha 1917, Asam Chhatra Sanmilan 1916), Partition of Bengal & Eastern Bengal and Assam (1905-1911), Non-Cooperation Movement in Assam (1920-22 - Visit of Mahatma Gandhi 1921, Boycott of foreign goods, Opium eradication campaign, Forest satyagraha, Resignation of Tarun Ram Phukan, Nabin Chandra Bardoloi, Bishnuram Medhi, Chandranath Sharma, Striking of tea garden workers - Charger Gola exodus), Assam Provincial Congress Committee (APCC 1921), Civil Disobedience Movement in Assam (1930-34 - Salt Satyagraha, Cunningham Circular boycott, Martyrdom of Kushal Konwar, Role of Tyagbir Hem Baruah, Omeo Kumar Das, Pushpalata Das), Tribal Movements (All Assam Plains Tribal League 1933, Bodo Movement, Kalicharan Brahma), Provincial Autonomy & Coalition Ministries (Sir Muhammad Saadulla Ministry, Gopinath Bordoloi Congress Coalition Ministry 1938), Line System & Immigration issue, Quit India Movement in Assam (1942 - Mass participation, Underground activities, Mrityu Bahini & Shanti Sena, Kanaklata Barua & Mukunda Kakati martyrdom at Gohpur, Bhogeswari Phukanani martyrdom at Barhampur, Tilak Deka, Kushal Konwar execution on false sabotage charges), Cabinet Mission & Grouping Scheme (Section C proposal to group Assam with Bengal, Historic resistance led by Lokapriya Gopinath Bordoloi with blessings of Mahatma Gandhi, Preservation of Assam's identity), Sylhet Referendum (1947), Independence & Integration of Assam

Subject: Geography of India & World
Topic: Physical, Economic & Human Geography
Subtopics: Origin of Earth, Earth's interior structure, Plate Tectonics, Continental Drift Theory, Earthquakes & Volcanoes, Geomorphic processes (Weathering, Mass wasting, Erosion, Fluvial, Glacial, Aeolian, Karst, Coastal landforms), Atmosphere (Composition, Structure, Temperature distribution, Atmospheric pressure & Wind belts, Air masses, Fronts, Jet Streams, Tropical & Extratropical Cyclones), Climatology & Monsoon mechanism (El Nino, La Nina, IOD), Oceanography (Ocean relief, Temperature, Salinity, Ocean Currents, Tides, Coral reefs & bleaching), Natural Resources (Soil types, Soil erosion & conservation, Forests & vegetation types, Water resources, Mineral resources - Iron ore, Bauxite, Copper, Manganese, Mica, Non-metallic minerals), Energy Resources (Coal, Petroleum, Natural Gas, Nuclear, Solar, Wind, Hydroelectric, Geothermal), Agriculture of India (Cropping patterns, Rice, Wheat, Cotton, Sugarcane, Tea, Coffee, Green Revolution, Blue Revolution, Precision farming), Manufacturing Industries (Iron & steel, Cotton textiles, Petrochemicals, Automobile, Information Technology, Industrial corridors), Human Geography (Demographic transition, Population distribution, Density, Growth, Sex ratio, Literacy, Urbanization, Migration patterns, Scheduled Tribes distribution in India)

Subject: Geography of Assam
Topic: Physiography, Climate, Drainage & Environment of Assam
Subtopics: Geographical location and administrative boundaries (Inter-state & International borders), Physiographic divisions (Brahmaputra Valley, Barak Valley, Karbi Anglong Hills, Dima Hasao/North Cachar Hills), Geological structure and tectonic setting (Seismic Zone V vulnerability), Drainage System of Assam (Brahmaputra River - Origin, Course, Major North bank tributaries: Subansiri, Ranganadi, Dikrong, Jia Bharali, Gabharu, Belsiri, Dhansiri North, Puthimari, Pagladiya, Manas, Beki, Aie, Champamati, Gaurang, Gangadhar, Sankosh; Major South bank tributaries: Burhi Dihing, Disang, Dikhow, Jhanji, Bhogdoi, Kakodonga, Dhansiri South, Kopili, Kulsi, Dudhnoi, Krishnai, Jinjiram; Majuli Island - World's largest inhabited riverine island; Barak River System - Course, Tributaries: Jiri, Siri, Madhura, Jatinga, Sonai, Rukni, Dhaleswari, Singla, Longai; Surma and Kushiyara branches), Flood and Riverbank Erosion problem in Assam (Causes, Hydro-meteorological factors, Sediment load, Bank erosion at Palasbari, Rohmoria, Majuli, Flood control measures, Brahmaputra Board, Water Resources Department initiatives), Climate of Assam (Sub-tropical humid climate, Seasonal rhythm, Pre-monsoon showers, South-West Monsoon, Retreating monsoon, Temperature & Rainfall distribution), Soils of Assam (Alluvial soil - Old and New alluvium, Red soil, Hill soil, Laterite soil; Soil erosion and soil fertility management), Forest and Wildlife Resources of Assam (Forest cover types - Tropical Wet Evergreen, Semi-Evergreen, Tropical Moist Deciduous, Riverine forests; State forest statistics; 7 National Parks: Kaziranga NP - World Heritage Site, Manas NP - World Heritage Site & Biosphere Reserve, Orang NP, Nameri NP, Raimona NP, Dihing Patkai NP, Dibru-Saikhowa NP - Biosphere Reserve; Wildlife Sanctuaries: Pobitora, Chakrashila - Golden Langur habitat, Hoollongapar Gibbon - Hoolock Gibbon sanctuary, Laokhowa, Burachapori, Bornadi, Panidihing Bird Sanctuary, Bherjan-Borajan-Padumoni; Deepor Beel - Ramsar Wetland Site; Major Faunal species: Greater One-Horned Rhinoceros, Asian Elephant, Royal Bengal Tiger, Pygmy Hog, Golden Langur, Wild Water Buffalo, Hoolock Gibbon, White-Winged Wood Duck / Deo Hah - State Bird, Gangetic River Dolphin / Xihu - State Aquatic Animal; Man-Animal Conflict issues), Mineral & Energy Resources (Petroleum & Natural Gas deposits: Digboi - Asia's first oil well 1889, Naharkatiya, Moran-Hugrijan, Rudrasagar, Lakwa, Geleki, Borholla; Coal deposits: Makum Coalfield, Ledo, Margherita, Dilli-Jeypore; Limestone deposits: Karbi Anglong, Dima Hasao - Dillai Parbat, Umrangso; China clay, Sillimanite, Quartz, Feldspar, Glass sand; Hydropower potential and projects: Karbi Langpi, Kopili, Khandong, Lower Kopili HEP; Non-conventional energy initiatives)

Subject: Indian Polity & Governance
Topic: Constitutional Framework & Political System
Subtopics: Historical background of the Constitution (Regulating Act 1773 to Independence Act 1947), Constituent Assembly (Making of Constitution, Committees, Drafting process, Enactment & Commencement), Preamble (Philosophical foundations, Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic, Justice, Liberty, Equality, Fraternity, Amendment of Preamble), Salient features of Indian Constitution, Union and its Territory (Articles 1-4, Reorganization of States), Citizenship (Articles 5-11, Citizenship Act 1955, CAA, NRC, Overseas Citizenship), Fundamental Rights (Articles 12-35: Right to Equality 14-18, Right to Freedom 19-22, Right against Exploitation 23-24, Right to Freedom of Religion 25-28, Cultural & Educational Rights 29-30, Right to Constitutional Remedies 32 - Writs: Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Certiorari, Quo-Warranto), Directive Principles of State Policy (Articles 36-51: Socialistic, Gandhian, Liberal-Intellectual principles, Fundamental Rights vs DPSP conflicts), Fundamental Duties (Article 51A, Swaran Singh Committee, 42nd & 86th Amendments), Amendment of the Constitution (Article 368, Types of amendments, Basic Structure Doctrine - Shankari Prasad, Golaknath, Kesavananda Bharati, Minerva Mills cases), System of Government (Parliamentary vs Presidential, Federal vs Unitary, Center-State Relations: Legislative, Administrative, Financial relations, Inter-State Council, Zonal Councils, Finance Commission, GST Council), Emergency Provisions (National Emergency Article 352, President's Rule / State Emergency Article 356, Financial Emergency Article 360), Union Executive (President: Election, Qualifications, Powers, Pardoning power Article 72, Impeachment; Vice-President; Prime Minister; Union Council of Ministers; Cabinet Committees; Attorney General of India), Union Legislature / Parliament (Rajya Sabha & Lok Sabha composition, Presiding officers: Speaker, Chairman; Parliamentary procedures, Sessions, Quorum, Motions, Question Hour, Zero Hour; Legislative procedure: Ordinary Bills, Money Bills Article 110, Financial Bills, Constitution Amendment Bills; Parliamentary Committees: PAC, Estimates, COPU, Standing Committees; Parliamentary Privileges), State Executive (Governor: Appointment, Powers, Discretionary powers, Constitutional role; Chief Minister; State Council of Ministers; Advocate General of the State), State Legislature (Vidhan Sabha & Vidhan Parishad structure, legislative procedures, powers), Judiciary (Supreme Court of India: Composition, Appointment of Judges - Collegium system, NJAC controversy, Jurisdiction: Original, Appellate, Advisory Article 143, Review, Writ jurisdiction Article 32, Judicial Review, Judicial Activism, Public Interest Litigation / PIL; High Courts: Composition, Appointment, Jurisdiction Article 226, Gauhati High Court jurisdiction over Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram, Arunachal Pradesh; Subordinate Courts: District Judges, Sessions Judges, Civil Judges, Judicial Magistrates, Fast Track Courts, Gram Nyayalayas, Lok Adalats), Local Self-Government (73rd Constitutional Amendment Act 1992 - Panchayati Raj Institutions: 3-tier structure, Compulsory & Voluntary provisions, 11th Schedule 29 functional items, State Election Commission, State Finance Commission, Assam Panchayat Act 1994; 74th Constitutional Amendment Act 1992 - Urban Local Bodies: Municipal Corporations, Municipal Boards, Town Committees, 12th Schedule 18 functional items, Guwahati Municipal Corporation / GMC Act), Special Provisions for Special Categories (Sixth Schedule of the Constitution - Administration of Tribal Areas in Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram: Autonomous District Councils - BTR / Bodoland Territorial Region, Karbi Anglong Autonomous Council / KAAC, North Cachar Hills Autonomous Council / NCHAC - Dima Hasao; Powers, Functioning, Village Councils; Statutory Autonomous Councils in Assam: Mising, Rabha Hasong, Tiwa, Deori, Sonowal Kachari, Thengal Kachari Autonomous Councils; Fifth Schedule vs Sixth Schedule comparison; Special Category States, Article 371A to 371J provisions), Constitutional & Non-Constitutional Bodies (Election Commission of India, UPSC & APSC, CAG of India, National Commissions for SC, ST, OBC; NITI Aayog, NHRC & AHRC, Central Information Commission / State Information Commission, CVC, CBI, Lokpal & Lokayukta of Assam)

Subject: Economy of India & Assam
Topic: Macroeconomics, Public Finance & Economic Landscape of Assam
Subtopics: National Income Accounting (GDP, GNP, NNP, GVA, Factor Cost, Market Price, Real vs Nominal GDP, Green GDP), Economic Growth vs Economic Development, Human Development Index (HDI), Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI), Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), Planning in India (History of Five Year Plans, NITI Aayog - structure, objectives, Atal Innovation Mission), Monetary Policy (Reserve Bank of India - functions, Quantitative instruments: Repo Rate, Reverse Repo Rate, SDF, MSF, Bank Rate, CRR, SLR, Open Market Operations; Qualitative instruments; Monetary Policy Committee / MPC, Inflation Targeting framework), Inflation (Concepts, Demand-pull, Cost-push, CPI, WPI, Core Inflation, Inflation spiral, Measures to control inflation), Banking System in India (Commercial Banks, Scheduled Banks, Public Sector Banks consolidation, Regional Rural Banks, Small Finance Banks, Payments Banks, Non-Banking Financial Companies / NBFCs, NPA crisis, IBC 2016, SARFAESI Act, Digital Banking, UPI, CBDC / e-Rupee), Financial Markets (Money Market - Call money, Treasury bills, Commercial paper, Certificate of deposit; Capital Market - Primary & Secondary markets, Shares, Debentures, Mutual Funds, SEBI regulations, Stock Exchanges - BSE, NSE), Public Finance & Budgeting (Union Budget, Components of Revenue Budget & Capital Budget, Revenue Receipts, Capital Receipts, Revenue Expenditure, Capital Expenditure, Fiscal Deficit, Revenue Deficit, Primary Deficit, FRBM Act 2003, Public Debt management), Taxation System (Direct Taxes - Income tax, Corporate tax; Indirect Taxes - GST structure, CGST, SGST, IGST, GST Council, Direct Tax Code proposals, Tax reforms), External Sector (Balance of Payments - Current Account & Capital Account, Foreign Exchange Reserves, Exchange Rate determination, FDI vs FPI, Foreign Trade Policy, WTO, Trade agreements), Economy of Assam (State Gross Domestic Product / GSDP composition, Sectoral contribution: Agriculture, Industry, Services; Agriculture in Assam - Monocropping, Rice production, High-yielding varieties, Assam Agribusiness and Rural Transformation Project / APART, Organic farming initiatives; Tea Industry of Assam - History, Acreage, Production, Small tea growers contribution, Guwahati Tea Auction Centre / GTAC, Problems facing tea industry; Petroleum & Petrochemical Sector - Oil exploration by OIL & ONGC, Refineries: Digboi, Guwahati, Bongaigaon, Numaligarh / NRL expansion, Brahmaputra Cracker and Polymer Limited / BCPL at Lepetkata, Assam Gas Company Limited / AGCL, Assam Petro-chemicals Limited / APL at Namrup; Sericulture of Assam - Muga Silk / Golden Silk with GI tag, Eri Silk / Endi / Ahimsa silk, Pat Silk / Mulberry, Tasar silk, Sualkuchi silk weaving cluster; Traditional Cottage Industries - Bell metal industry of Sarthebari with GI tag, Brass craft of Hajo, Terracotta craft of Asharikandi, Bamboo & Cane craft, Handloom weaving; Infrastructure & Connectivity - Bridges over Brahmaputra: Saraighat, New Saraighat, Kolia Bhomora, New Bhomora, Naranarayan Setu, Bogibeel Rail-cum-Road bridge, Dhola-Sadiya / Bhupen Hazarika bridge, Upcoming Kumarikata-Gohpur underwater tunnel; Inland Waterways: National Waterway 2 / NW-2 on Brahmaputra (Dhubri to Sadiya), Pandu Multi-modal terminal, Jogighapa Multi-Modal Logistics Park / MMLP; Act East Policy and North East Economic Corridor; Assam State Flagship Welfare & Economic Schemes: Orunodoi 3.0, Mission Basundhara 3.0, Mukhya Mantri Nijut Moina scheme, Atmanirbhar Asom Abhijan, Pragyan Bharati, Arundhati Gold Scheme, Amrit Brikshya Andolan, Swanirbhar Naari, Mukhya Mantri Lok Sevak Seba, Mukhya Mantri Mahila Udyamita Abhiyan)

Subject: Quantitative Aptitude & Mathematics
Topic: Class X Arithmetic & Numerical Ability
Subtopics: Number System, Real numbers, Divisibility rules, Prime factorization, HCF and LCM applications, Fractions, Decimals, Surds & Indices, Simplification & BODMAS, Percentage calculations, Profit, Loss and Discount, Marked price, Successive discounts, Simple Interest (SI) and Compound Interest (CI) with annual/half-yearly compounding, Ratio and Proportion, Direct and Inverse proportions, Third/Fourth proportional, Mean proportional, Partnership and Profit sharing ratio, Average, Weighted average, Mixtures and Alligation, Time and Work, Alternate work, Efficiency ratios, Pipes and Cisterns (Inlet/Outlet filling/emptying problems), Time, Speed and Distance, Average speed, Relative speed, Problems on Trains (Crossing stationary/moving objects, bridges, platforms), Boats and Streams (Upstream, Downstream, Still water speed), Races and Circular tracks, Mensuration 2D: Area and Perimeter of Triangles (Equilateral, Isosceles, Scalene, Heron's formula), Quadrilaterals (Rectangle, Square, Parallelogram, Rhombus, Trapezium), Circles, Sectors, Rings; Mensuration 3D: Surface Area and Volume of Cubes, Cuboids, Right circular Cylinders, Cones, Spheres, Hemispheres, Frustums; Basic Statistics: Arithmetic Mean, Median, Mode, Range, Standard Deviation basics

Subject: Logical Reasoning & Mental Ability
Topic: Verbal, Analytical & Non-Verbal Reasoning
Subtopics: Analogies (Semantic, Number, Letter), Classification / Odd One Out, Series Completion (Number series, Letter series, Alpha-numeric series, Mixed series, Continuous pattern series), Coding and Decoding (Letter coding, Number coding, Substitution, Deciphering message codes), Blood Relations (Family tree, Direct/Indirect relations, Coded relations), Direction and Distance Sense Test (Shadow problems, Pythagoras theorem applications, Turns and Cardinal directions), Seating Arrangements (Linear single/parallel rows, Circular facing center/outside, Square/Rectangular table, Complex matrix arrangements), Order and Ranking (Position from left/right, Total persons, Interchanging positions), Syllogisms (Venn diagram method, Statements & Conclusions, Categorical propositions, Either-or cases, Possibility cases), Logical Venn Diagrams (Geometric diagrams, Intersection sets), Mathematical Operations (Symbol substitution, Equation balancing), Clocks and Calendars (Angle between hands, Reflex angle, Faulty clocks, Odd days calculation, Day of the week on any date, Leap years), Cube and Dice (Opposite faces, Unfolded dice nets, Painted cubes cutting), Critical Reasoning: Statement and Assumptions (Implicit/Explicit assumptions), Statement and Arguments (Strong vs Weak arguments), Statement and Course of Action (Feasible administrative actions), Cause and Effect, Statement and Conclusions / Inferences, Decision Making and Problem Solving (Administrative case scenarios, Ethical dilemma choices, Resource prioritization), Non-Verbal Reasoning: Series, Analogies, Classification of Figures, Analytical Reasoning (Counting triangles, squares, rectangles, straight lines), Mirror Images and Water Images, Embedded Figures, Completion of Incomplete Patterns, Paper Folding and Paper Cutting, Rule Detection

Subject: Comprehension & Data Interpretation
Topic: Reading Comprehension & Data Representation
Subtopics: Unseen English Reading Comprehension passages covering Socio-Economic, Environmental, Philosophical, Scientific, and Governance themes; Contextual vocabulary, Central idea, Primary purpose, Author's tone, Direct factual questions, Critical inference, Logical deductions, Assumptions underlying the passage; Interpersonal Skills including Communication Skills; Data Interpretation (Class X Level): Tabular Data representation, Line Graphs, Simple and Composite Bar Charts, Pie Charts (Single & Dual pie charts with percentage/degree conversion), Histograms, Frequency Polygons, Data Sufficiency (Evaluating sufficiency of Data Statements to answer analytical problems)

Subject: Conventional Essay
Topic: Essay Writing on National, Socio-Economic & Philosophical Themes
Subtopics: Candidates write two in-depth conventional essays (1000-1200 words each) selected from multiple sections: Section A covering Philosophical, Ethical, Cultural, Education, Women Empowerment, and Socio-Economic Development themes; Section B covering Science & Technology, Environmental Challenges, Sustainable Development, International Relations, and North-East & Assam-specific Developmental, Cultural, and Ecological dynamics. Evaluated on structured thinking, clarity of expression, balanced perspective, logical coherence, and depth of analysis

Subject: Indian Heritage, History & Geography
Topic: Indian Culture, Modern History, World History, Society & Geography
Subtopics: Indian Culture & Heritage: Salient aspects of Art forms, Literature, and Architecture from Ancient to Modern times; Modern Indian History: Significant events, personalities, and issues from the middle of the eighteenth century until the present; The Freedom Struggle: Its various stages and important contributors/contributions from different parts of the country; Post-independence consolidation and reorganization within the country; History of the World: Events from 18th century such as Industrial Revolution, World Wars, Redrawal of national boundaries, Colonization, Decolonization, Political philosophies like Communism, Capitalism, Socialism - their forms and effect on the society; Salient features of Indian Society, Diversity of India; Role of women and women's organization, Population and associated issues, Poverty and developmental issues, Urbanization, their problems and their remedies; Effects of Globalization on Indian society; Social empowerment, Communalism, Regionalism & Secularism; Salient features of world's physical geography; Distribution of key natural resources across the world (including South Asia and the Indian sub-continent); Factors responsible for the location of primary, secondary, and tertiary sector industries in various parts of the world (including India); Important Geophysical phenomena such as Earthquakes, Tsunami, Volcanic activity, Cyclone etc., Geographical features and their location-changes in critical geographical features (including water-bodies and ice-caps) and in flora and fauna and the effects of such changes

Structure, organization and functioning of the Executive and the Judiciary: Ministries and Departments of the Government; Pressure groups and formal/informal associations and their role in the Polity; Government policies and interventions for development in various sectors and issues arising out of their design and implementation; Development processes and the development industry: The role of NGOs, SHGs, various groups and associations, donors, charities, institutional and other stakeholders; Welfare schemes for vulnerable sections of the population by the Centre and States and the performance of these schemes; Mechanisms, laws, institutions and Bodies constituted for the protection and betterment of these vulnerable sections; Subject: Technology, Economic Dev, Biodiversity, Security & Disaster Mgmt
Topic: Economic Growth, Agriculture, Infrastructure, S&T, Ecology & Internal Security

Science and Technology: Developments and their applications and effects in everyday life; Achievements of Indians in science & technology; Indigenization of technology and developing new technology; Awareness in the fields of IT, Space, Computers, Robotics, Nanotechnology, Bio-technology and issues relating to intellectual property rights (IPR);
